nodes.title: Progressive Conditional Diffusion Model for Multistage Spectral Restoration of Remote Sensing Image
nodes.methodology: Proposes a progressive conditional diffusion model (PCDM) with channel synthesis and image reconstruction modules. Constructs multiple conditional diffusion models, sharing parameters between multispectral images and IRM for spectral up-sampling.
nodes.contribution: Introduces PCDM with multistage constraints, global-local channel synthesis, and feature fusion modules for accurate intermediate feature generation.

nodes.title: The Influence of Emotion on Keyboard Typing: An Experimental Study Using Auditory Stimuli
nodes.dataset: Keystroke data collected from 52 subjects typing a number sequence after exposure to IADS stimuli.
nodes.methodology: Controlled experiment using International Affective Digitized Sounds (IADS) to induce emotional states. Two-way Valence x Arousal ANOVA analyzed keystroke duration, latency, and accuracy.
nodes.contribution: Supports that keystroke duration and latency are arousal-driven. Highlights potential for personalized models to enhance emotion recognition accuracy.

nodes.title: The Laws of Emotion
nodes.methodology: Formulating empirical laws of emotion based on causal mechanisms and cognitive appraisals of events, validated through correlations and computational models.
nodes.contribution: Proposes a framework of emotion laws (e.g., situational meaning, conservation of momentum) to systematically study emotional responses and regulation.

nodes.title: MoodSwipe: A Soft Keyboard that Suggests Messages Based on User-Specified Emotions
nodes.dataset: EmotionPush dataset (162,031 social dialog messages) with manual emotion labels for 8,818 messages, split into training (70%), validation (10%), and testing (20%) sets.
nodes.methodology: MoodSwipe uses emotion classification models trained on dialog data to suggest text based on user-specified emotions. A color-coded interface allows users to select emotions and view corresponding message suggestions.
nodes.contribution: 1) Novel emotion-labeled data collection via user interaction. 2) Bidirectional emotion sensing for text suggestion. 3) New interaction paradigm allowing users to provide context for suggestions.

nodes.title: The Experience of Emotion
nodes.methodology: Review of existing theories, integration into a framework combining phenomenological content and neurobiological processes, and discussion of philosophical perspectives like biological naturalism.
nodes.contribution: Introduces biological naturalism as a framework addressing both content and neurobiological processes in emotion experiences, challenging materialist and behaviorist views.
